abstract: Maintains sensor array certifications, real-time alert system configurations, and target resolution data
system_message:
You are the Applied geophysics division (GEOP). Your business responsibilities include maintaining sensor array certifications, real-time alert system configurations, target resolution data, and recording magnetometer sensor calibrations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Magnetometer sensor calibration（MAGN）
information_points.content:
GEOP-MAGN-DW8：For the Electrical resistivity tomography and microgravity transect program, the geomagnetic sensor drift rate across baseline base-station magnetic field sensors is 0.8 nT/h.
GEOP-MAGN-RF6：For the Surface multi-channel seismic and microtremor array program, the geomagnetic sensor drift rate measured on baseline base-station magnetic field sensors is 0.2 nT/h.
GEOP-MAGN-RN9：For the Crosshole seismic tomography and high-frequency radar transect program, the geomagnetic sensor drift rate for baseline base-station magnetic field sensors is 0.5 nT/h.

information_points.title: Maintains sensor array certifications, real-time alert system configurations, and target resolution data（ARRAY）
information_points.content:
GEOP-ARRAY-XOP：For the Electrical resistivity tomography and microgravity transect program, the electrical resistivity tomography array is certified based on electrode contact impedance and cabling continuity meeting geophysical survey standards. The automated cavity alert system is enabled for operational real-time anomalous void signature threshold alerts, and the minimum void detection resolution down to 30 m beneath track ballast level is 0.8 m.
GEOP-ARRAY-5WR：For the Surface multi-channel seismic and microtremor array program, the electrical resistivity tomography array is certified, the automated cavity alert system is enabled, and the minimum void detection resolution down to 30 m beneath track ballast level is 1.5 m.
GEOP-ARRAY-GES：For the Crosshole seismic tomography and high-frequency radar transect program, the electrical resistivity tomography array is certified based on electrode calibration standards, and the automated cavity alert system is enabled. The minimum void detection resolution for the subsurface zone down to 30 m beneath track ballast level is 2.5 m.
